title: Independent run-03 replication finds above-chance ictal high-frequency SOZ localization in 31 HUP SEEG patients
abstract: An independent implementation on third ictal recordings from OpenNeuro ds004100 tested a narrow claim from SCI target sha256:f5d23542d59d9a29ca82001abbb12da78d9ae48fb56dcf2f894156ea6b7c44b2. Using a simpler 20–100 Hz ictal/preictal power-ratio score, mean patient-level SOZ AUC was 0.703 in 31 evaluable run-03 recordings (26/31 >0.5; exact sign-flip p=0.000065). This confirms above-chance association in this selected third-seizure cohort, not superiority to other features or clinical utility.

citations.reason: Independent implementation and unused run-03 test of its ictal-power SOZ-localization claim.
